injury_predictions.name: Josh Jacobs
injury_predictions.note: Pleaded no contest Sept 10 (criminal case resolved). Remains on Commissioner's Exempt List (paid, can't play/practice); NFL confirms no timetable for discipline. Standard domestic-violence-case suspension is 6 games, could be shorter or longer.

injury_predictions.name: Zach Charbonnet
injury_predictions.note: Reserve/PUP (ACL). Macdonald: not activated for Week 6 TNF at DEN. Must be activated by 10/22 (21-day window); Week 7 vs KC (10/25) is next.

injury_predictions.name: Jordyn Tyson
injury_predictions.note: IR (designated to return), right hamstring strain. Schefter (10/5): making progress but won't be activated before Week 7 at the soonest; Saints bye is Week 8, so Week 9 vs CLE is the more likely debut. Moore said he would not practice this week. Week 7 remains possible.
injury_predictions.source: Adam Schefter (ESPN) via The Fantasy Footballers, Kellen Moore via NBC Sports

injury_predictions.name: TreVeyon Henderson
injury_predictions.note: Right high-ankle sprain, hurt Week 5 vs LV; MRI Monday 10/12. Schefter: expected to miss multiple weeks, no surgery, not reported on IR. No firm timeline - Week 9 (three missed games) is a midpoint estimate, unconfirmed. Rhamondre Stevenson leads the backfield meanwhile.
injury_predictions.source: Adam Schefter (ESPN) via RotoWire, Pats Pulpit

injury_predictions.name: Jadarian Price
injury_predictions.note: Placed on IR 10/3 after aggravating a chest injury (first hurt Week 2) in practice. Must miss at least 4 games (Weeks 4-7); Week 8 is the earliest.
injury_predictions.source: Seahawks via NBC Sports (PFT), FOX 13 Seattle, TSN
